Somewhere beyond the mist, a bell buoy rang softly, as if the sea had finally decided to answer her.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市浸在深蓝的寂静里。高楼窗灯稀疏，像未睡人的眼睛。街道被夜露打湿，红绿灯独自切换，拉长空荡的光影。保洁员的扫帚划过路面，发出细碎清醒的声响。便利店透出暖光，蒸笼冒着白汽，给夜归人留一处温柔角落。远处偶有货车驶过，轰鸣渐远。天边泛白，海棠花在风里轻颤，城市缓缓睁开眼睛，迎接新的一天。","w03":"- Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Each call keeps going until it reaches a simple base case, like a number reaching zero, where no more self-calls are needed.\n- Then the answers pass back upward, one call at a time, until the original function gives the final result."}
